the formula gives $11.","case2_error":"Explicitly evaluates 26 + 22 as 38 instead of 48, producing an incorrect union count.","reason":"The first provides an unsupported answer after a correct formula; the second shows a specific numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03154","case1_error":"Treats four bags as four peanuts, omitting the 30 peanuts per bag.","case2_error":"Uses the 50-hour requirement as a trip count, mislabels accumulated minutes as daily time, and divides incompatible units.","reason":"The first confuses containers with their contents;
